faqs.a: A 50% deposit starts the project and the rest is due before launch. Projects over $2,500 split into 50% to start, 25% at design approval and 25% before launch. Pay by Zelle or cash. Card payments are coming soon. Invoices are due in 7 days.

es.a: Un depósito del 50% inicia el proyecto y el resto se paga antes del lanzamiento. Los proyectos de más de $2,500 se dividen en 50% al inicio, 25% al aprobar el diseño y 25% antes del lanzamiento. Puede pagar por Zelle o en efectivo. Pronto aceptaremos tarjeta. Las facturas vencen en 7 días.

faqs.a: The deposit is non-refundable once work starts. Work starts at the kickoff call or the first design, whichever comes first.

faqs.q: What if I need work outside my package?
faqs.a: Need something that's not here? Tell us on your quote call and we'll send you a clear, flat quote.
Yes. Your Wix account and domain are in your name, and you pay Wix for them directly. Your logo files and full admin access are handed over after the final payment.

es.a: Sí. Su cuenta de Wix y su dominio quedan a su nombre, y usted le paga a Wix directamente. Los archivos de su logo y el acceso completo de administrador se entregan después del pago final.

faqs.a: Yes. Your Wix plan and domain are billed by Wix to you, in your name. Our prices cover the design and build, and care plans cover upkeep.

faqs.q: Will you show my site as an example of your work?
faqs.a: Finished work may be shown in our portfolio unless you tell us you'd rather opt out.

faqs.q: How long does a website take?
faqs.a: 1 to 4 weeks depending on the package: 1 to 2 weeks for Launch, 2 to 3 weeks for Growth and 3 to 4 weeks for Premium. The clock starts once we have your text, photos and logo.

es.a: De 1 a 4 semanas según el paquete: de 1 a 2 semanas para Launch, de 2 a 3 para Growth y de 3 a 4 para Premium. El tiempo empieza a contar cuando tenemos sus textos, fotos y logo.

faqs.q: What counts as a round of changes?
faqs.a: One list of all your feedback, sent within 5 business days. Launch includes 2 rounds, Growth and Premium include 3. Extra rounds are $100 per hour.

faqs.q: What if I go quiet during the project?
faqs.a: After 30 days with no reply, the project pauses and the next payment comes due. Restarting costs $150.

faqs.q: Is a care plan the same as my Wix plan?
faqs.a: No. Wix hosts your site and bills you for that. A care plan is us taking care of the site: edits, checks and fixes.
Yes. Plans are billed monthly in advance, and when you cancel your plan runs to the end of that month.
No. Each month's edit hours are for that month.

faqs.q: Is there a deal for starting at launch?
faqs.a: Yes. Your first month is half off when you start a care plan at launch.
